usedFor: Small Swiss businesses keep their books in Aarven, and “New Booking” starts a template when new bookings appear.

bestTemplate.name: “New Booking” in Aarven, then “Add Row To Table” in Microsoft Excel
bestTemplate.why: Each new booking becomes a row in a spreadsheet, so your accounts also sit in a file you can sort.

watchOut: “New Booking” in Aarven is polling, checked once a day, so bookings show up the next day.
